DIMENSIONS FOR MOUNTING FLANGES FOR 
IN-LINE FUEL INJECTION PUMPS FOR 
MULTI-CYLINDER COMPRESSION IGNITION ENGINES 



1. Scope — Specifies the maximum dimensions for three and four slot mounting flanges of 
in-line fuel injection pumps for multi-cylinder diesel engines. 

2. Dimensions — Shall conform to those given in 2.2 and 2.3. 

2.1 Dimensions other than those specified in 2.2 and 2.3 may be used for special applications 
subject to agreement between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

2.2 4-Slot Mounting Flange — Applicable for 3 ( 4 and 6 cylinder engines ( see Fig. 1 & Notes 1 and 2). 

2.3 3-Slot Mounting Flange— Applicable for 2,3,4 and 6 cylinder engines ( see Fig. 2 & Notes 1 and 2 ). 

Note 1 — For shaft end details see Indian Standard 'Dimension for tapers for shaft ends and hubs for fuel 
Injection equipment ( under preparation )'. 

Note 2 — Details not specified may be selected suitably. 

2.4 For 2-cylinder fuel injection pumps, mounting flanges shall conform to Fig. 3. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 



In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived from 
DIN 73365 Blatt 4 Einspritzpumpen fur dieselmotoren — Dreischlitz — und Viersulitz — Bejestigungs 
flansch — (Injection pumps for diesel engines, three slots and four slots mounting flange, issued 
by DIN Deutsches Institut for Normung.
